name: Paper-Cutout Illustration
description: Layered paper-cutout 2D historical illustration. Flat illustrated shapes with subtle dimensional layering, visible paper and fiber texture, handmade cut edges, and soft layered shadows.
system_instructions:
Execute as a layered paper-cutout 2D historical illustration with a premium cinematic 2D cutout animation aesthetic. Flat illustrated shapes with subtle dimensional layering, visible paper and fiber texture, and slightly imperfect handmade cut edges.

All human characters, animals, ships, buildings, waves, smoke puffs, and scenery must appear as physically cut cardstock shapes assembled in distinct physical layers. Simple expressive characters with clear silhouettes, paper-crafted clothing, and layered anatomy.

Warm, muted historical color palette: parchment beige, warm brown, muted naval blue, dusty orange, olive, charcoal, subdued cream, and aged paper tones. Soft cinematic lighting with delicate paper-like drop shadows creating physical depth between overlapping layers.

Strictly clean artwork: no text, no lettering, no modern objects, no 3D CGI plastic rendering, no photorealism, no vector flatness without paper fiber texture. Key principle: PromptBeast should apply the visual identity consistently but let the script control the actual scene, lighting, atmosphere, camera, composition, and visual storytelling.
